methodology.protocol: HTTP/1.1 loopback with keep-alive and compression disabled
methodology.javascriptMode: production: NODE_ENV=production is set by the driver and confirmed by each JavaScript server's health endpoint; React also reports which react-dom server build it loaded
methodology.concurrencyModel: one server process per engine; Proa runs 1 Tokio worker thread and 1 local-stream worker so every engine is measured per core
methodology.reactRenderPath: Bun production renderToReadableStream; shell piped immediately through Readable.fromWeb; no allReady wait
methodology.proaRenderPath: RouteResponse::ssr_stream_send: the compiler-proved Send stream that Axum polls directly
methodology.loadGenerator: 24 forked Bun worker processes share the arrival schedule and validate every response
methodology.latency: both client-dispatch and scheduled-arrival latency; scheduled latency includes generator lag and server queueing
methodology.throughput: successful full streamed responses completed inside a fixed steady-state observation window after pre-roll
methodology.cpu: server process CPU-time delta from process counters
methodology.memory: server RSS sampled with ps every 100 ms; peak is the largest sample
methodology.validation: every measured response must contain the shell, every fallback and resolved-panel marker, and every product card
methodology.asyncValues: typed in-memory delayed values; no serialization or external I/O
methodology.processLifecycle: fresh production server process for every engine/rate/repeat phase
methodology.proaConfirmationCheck: after the per-core matrix, Proa reruns the top target rate with the confirmation worker-thread count so the per-core knee is shown to be a thread budget
